designationHistory.indexText: Secretary of Agriculture Clayton Yeutter designated the Butte Valley Land Utilization Project (CA-22) in Siskiyou County, California, as the Butte Valley National Grassland.

authority.citation: Designation order of Jan. 18, 1991, published at 56 F.R. 8279 (Feb. 28, 1991); 36 CFR 213.1(e)

designationHistory.note: The signed order printed in the Federal Register is dated Jan. 18, 1991; the preamble of the same notice misprints the year once as 1990. The notice's effective date is Feb. 28, 1991.

sources.name: Francis Moul, 'National Grasslands,' Encyclopedia of the Great Plains (University of Nebraska-Lincoln)
